observations.posthog_connection: These tests cover PostgreSQL CDC decoding behavior, including transaction buffer limits, spill-to-disk behavior, and concurrent transaction budget sharing. This could help PostHog maintain compatibility and reliability of its warehouse ingestion and CDC replication, but the tests are not production implementation.
